name: Cheating
overview: Scripture calls believers to live with integrity and honesty, warning that deceit and perversion of truth lead to personal destruction and divine displeasure. Proverbs emphasizes that those who lie or act perversely are known and rejected by God, while those who walk uprightly find security and delight in the Lord. Even in difficult circumstances, God's presence encourages strength and courage rather than resorting to dishonest means, such as cheating on a test. Trusting God for justice rather than seeking to repay evil by wrongdoing reflects a heart aligned with His commands.
